sections.h1: Why Your Social Budget Isn't Working
lead: Attribution models, audience segmentation, and platform strategy to turn spend into pipeline.
Most teams run social like a PR channel, posting brand news and hoping. Meanwhile, competitors are using social as a demand-gen engine. The gap isn't budget; it's strategy.

p: Last-click attribution credits social for sales it didn't drive. Use multi-touch models or test incrementality. Find out which platforms actually move pipeline.
Treat brand followers like a list of potential customers, not a vanity metric. Tailor messaging by job title, industry, and buying stage. Use LinkedIn/Twitter lists and lookalike audiences.
LinkedIn is for B2B demand-gen (pipeline). Twitter is for thought leadership and engagement. TikTok is for brand awareness, not yet for B2B sales. Allocate budget accordingly.

bullets: 2-3x ROI from B2B social ads (vs. 0.5x with generic spend)
15-25% lower CAC when social is part of mix
40-60% faster sales cycle for warm leads from social
